reference_observations: Tall pointed conical tree shape with many irregular, asymmetric bough layers extending wider toward the base
Topper is a tall faceted gold spire/finial with a rounded gold ball at its base — not a star
Gold bead garlands drape in gentle horizontal swags across multiple levels of the tree
Ornaments are densely distributed and varied: large round baubles in deep red with scroll patterns, warm gold, cream/silver, and amber/copper tones
Several white pine-cone shaped ornaments and a white snowflake ornament visible in the mid-section
A few small deep-blue elongated ornaments on the left side, plus scattered multicolour fairy lights (red, yellow, blue, green) throughout
Red star ornament visible on the lower right; small gold bells and icicle/teardrop drops near the base
Black cruciform metal stand at the base

changes: Replaced oversized independent backing with a round seven-unit border from actual vector geometry.
Clipped bead garlands and fairy lights to the exact foliage paths.
